text:
olivia: Quick check — finalizing dual-post plan for the benchmark + webinar next Wed. Need X thread + LinkedIn single post scheduled. Who can own copy and assets?
kim: I can own X thread copy. Will need final benchmark headline and a 2-line hook.
jon: I’ll own LinkedIn longcopy. Also can schedule both in Sprout. What time windows are we targeting?
tara: Webinar is 11am PT. For social we should do: X thread at 9:30am PT (warm), LinkedIn post at 10am PT (lead-in). Also schedule a reminder post same day 1 hour before.
leo: Quick question on messaging: do we run variant A (lead with latency/cost) vs B (lead with customer quote)? I vote A on X, B on LinkedIn.
olivia: Agreed — A on X, B on LinkedIn. kim — for X thread, 6 tweets: hook, stat, quick explainer, demo gif ask, CTA (register), reply-to-thread with slide link.
kim: Drafting now. Will include a short GIF (15s) of the console highlights. Need final GIF file and 1-sentence quote.
jon: For LinkedIn longcopy: headline, 3 bullets (what, why, how), CTA, and 2 CTAs in first comment. I’ll also include UTM params: utm_source=x_social&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_may2026.
tara: HubSpot routing: set lead source to "social-webinar" and auto-assign to SDR queue "inbound-webinar". Also add hidden property: first_touch_channel = social.
leo: For A/B on X we can pin variant A as the root tweet and publish variant B as a follow-up at 12pm PT to test engagement. Low friction.
olivia: Good. Social-bot — can you create a scheduling checklist and post it here?
social-bot: checklist created: 1) Final copy for X + LinkedIn 2) GIF + slide deck (PDF) 3) UTM links + CTA 4) Sprout schedule + approval 5) HubSpot routing + SDR note 6) Engagement follow-ups doc. Link: https://redwood.co/sched-checklist
kim: Copy draft (thread):
```
1/ Hook: "Shipping LLM apps? Serving is the new moat."
2/ Stat: "Benchmarks: 4x lower per-token cost vs naive infra."
3/ Quick explainer: "How we combine batching, KV cache, and routing."
4/ Demo gif: [attached]
5/ CTA: "Register: https://redwood.co/webinar"
6/ Reply: slide deck + TL;DR
```
kim: Need: final stat number from research (is it 3.8x or 4x?). olivia: Use 3.8x to be conservative.
jon: LinkedIn draft first pass ready, putting in drive: https://drive.redwood.co/marketing/linkedin-webinar-draft — please comment.
tara: Asset list to drop in thread: webinar_slide_deck_v3.pdf, demo_console_15s.gif, benchmark_onepager_v2.pdf, approved_quote_olivia.txt
leo: Engagement follow-ups: After registration, SDRs send a quick note. For social replies: assign owners — kim handles technical replies, tara handles logistics/registration questions, jon handles PR/press asks.
olivia: Approval flow: kim->jon->olivia. Need all assets + final copy by EOD Tuesday.
kim: I’ll push X thread draft by 3pm PT. jon: I’ll schedule LinkedIn after your sign-off.
social-bot: scheduled reminder: Tue 3:30pm PT -> #marketing: "final asset check".
olivia: One more ask — include one sentence for paid creative: 10-12 words, focused on cost per token. Can someone draft?
leo: Paid creative option: "Cut inference cost. Keep output quality. Ship faster."
olivia: Perfect. Thanks team — ping here when done. :rocket:
